## Report — housekeeping, 2026-09-30 21:42 ET

**T2 decisions: none.** The prompt named no event awaiting T2 and `due.py t2-list` is empty, so no `decision.json` was written. This step gated nothing and froze nothing.

**Freezes today (by code, not by this step):** `a2f6a47` — NKE 2026-10-01, PASS, **BLIND**. The manifest freezes at 14:40:04 ET against an entry open of 2026-10-01 09:30 ET, with both RFC 3161 tokens and six hashed files. It was captured at 14:31 ET (`075ddb7`) and decided by the per-event `t2` job of run 36731470987. That is the first complete chain in the pilot's history; `find events -name gate.json` now returns 2 (MU, NKE).

**PENDING changes: none — AEHR stays PENDING, and tonight was its last housekeeping run.** Code's probe returned `no_feed` (AEHR has no Q4-style IR feed and `investors.aehr.com` does not resolve), so I checked by hand:

| source | what it showed |
|---|---|
| `www.aehr.com/newsroom` (200) | newest item still 2026-09-28, the CEO Investor Summit release — a conference, not an earnings date |
| `www.aehr.com/events/` (200, **first time read**) | trade shows and conferences only, no earnings call |
| SEC EDGAR, CIK 0001040470 | newest are ARS 09-10 and DEF 14A 09-09, then Forms 4/144 — no 8-K carrying a date |
| yfinance | unchanged: 2026-11-02 15:00 ET, intraday and outside the window |
| Nasdaq | unchanged: 2026-10-05 `time-not-supplied`; absent from the Oct 1 and Oct 2 rows |

Its own ~7-day lead implied an announcement on 2026-09-28; it is two days late. Its earliest possible snapshot session is **tomorrow, 2026-10-01**, so once that window closes code marks AEHR INELIGIBLE `unconfirmed`. The pilot ends with no AEHR event.

**What went wrong:**

- **`actions: read` still does not reach this step.** Re-tested as the 09-29 log asked. `gh run list` and a raw `curl` on `/actions/runs` both return 403 with `x-accepted-github-permissions: actions=read`, although the grant is correctly declared on the `s2` job (`.github/workflows/s2-window.yml:125`). The token in the step env is scoped to this repo alone and does have contents read (`/repos/…` → 200), so a working token is present but is missing exactly the scope that was added. Most likely cause: `claude-code-action@v1` gets no `github_token:` input (lines 208–210), mints its own App token and overwrites `GITHUB_TOKEN`/`GH_TOKEN`, which a job-level `permissions:` block cannot touch. Fix needs a laptop session — pass `github_token: ${{ github.token }}`, or expose the job token under another name. Until then, "did the fire arrive or did the code crash" stays unanswerable from inside the runner.
- **The 23:00 UTC fire arrived 2 h 42 min late** (19:00 ET due, 21:42 ET started) — the same lateness as every day since 09-21. It cost nothing tonight; the cloud routine's earlier fire is what produced the in-window gate.
- Not a failure, but noted: the `ALPHAVANTAGE_API_KEY` gap is now closed in the workflow file (`s2` job `env:`, lines 126–130). Wednesday runs no mid-season screen, so it can only be confirmed on **Fri Oct 2**.
